1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, once you’ve shared that, please have your **order id** ready (it looks like **#W0000000**).
My name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187. I don’t have my order number handy right now.
noah_ito_3850
